name: Wally King, American Veterans Center
subject: I was a POW for two weeks
body:
My commander was right. Just not the way either of us meant.

| | | |
---
Friends,
---
On April 18, 1945, I walked up to my squadron commander and said, "This is my 75th mission. Don't you think it's time to quit?"He said, "Yeah. This is going to be your last mission."He was right. _Just not the way either of us meant._ My name is Wally King. I just turned 103. During World War II, I flew P-47 Thunderbolts over France and Germany with the 513th Fighter Squadron.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkb-OnDAQh5_GdIcY22uWwkWU1Uop7tqU1mQYWOuwTWwDrx9xu12q60bz5_v00_x-d-_oFx_nDwxsafcuF-cPLLimY0q5Hulg_ixOdtK8AbyBckjV7-w0NqOl0SjZsIV-0JehA31tHpZJ0pWGq1Rm0BdSJDVPEoz8Y65mGvrG2xMHAAp6uKihnRSCZsCuJ2DsQehuW0esXFpKsXDe8XT6GNNZpdhSCs1iH7WuRagfQt6FvBemLXOLgbMnjDtXzhgLcayc25RnIe_zxqW64ufI-ZnKIf0V6l7SlokdpZGFuv389QFG6g6ENFsNLvDotyDUjQP65dV8ngh1e2AesXx-kZ4jwrCin6NQN9zJ_W997VXOJ7XJdlwPvyy-mF7obj4tXxnrt5-yW_kvAAD__9vxnm8)
---
I grew up in rural Ohio. I went to all 12 grades in the same school building, and my graduating class had 32 students. All 16 of the boys served in the war.I'd wanted to fly since I was a kid building model airplanes. The P-47 was a tough, honest airplane. It could take a beating and bring you home.The mission I remember most came just before Christmas 1944, during the Battle of the Bulge.Our job was to knock out the German guns around Bastogne before the supply planes came in. Everything was buried in snow.When the parachutes dropped, men who had been dug in under all that white came up out of the ground and started dragging those supplies into town.**Friends, I'll never forget that sight.** _Then came April 18._ On the way home, my wingman spotted a gun on a railroad car, and we went down for a look. Flak hit my engine. Fire came over the windshield.I bailed out over German territory with civilians shooting at me on the way down.Friends, I was beaten, burned and terrified. I'd never given God much thought before that day, but right then, a peace came over me like nothing I'd ever felt. It stayed with me the whole two weeks I was a prisoner.**And it was a German doctor who got me home.** He was caring for badly wounded Americans in a house near the Russian front. When the war was all but over, he rode with us in two ambulances to the American lines, driving after midnight with no lights.I've often wondered how many of those boys would have lived without him.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkb-OnDAQh5_GdIcY22uWwkWU1Uop7tqU1mQYWOuwTWwDrx9xu12q60bz5_v00_x-d-_oFx_nDwxsafcuF-cPLLimY0q5Hulg_ixOdtK8AbyBckjV7-w0NqOl0SjZsIV-0JehA31tHpZJ0pWGq1Rm0BdSJDVPEoz8Y65mGvrG2xMHAAp6uKihnRSCZsCuJ2DsQehuW0esXFpKsXDe8XT6GNNZpdhSCs1iH7WuRagfQt6FvBemLXOLgbMnjDtXzhgLcayc25RnIe_zxqW64ufI-ZnKIf0V6l7SlokdpZGFuv389QFG6g6ENFsNLvDotyDUjQP65dV8ngh1e2AesXx-kZ4jwrCin6NQN9zJ_W997VXOJ7XJdlwPvyy-mF7obj4tXxnrt5-yW_kvAAD__9vxnm8)
---
_Above: I met with the boys of the 117_ _th_ _Air Refueling Wing of the Alabama National Guard before flying to Normandy, France in June 2025 for the 81_ _st_ _anniversary of D-Day. _
---
For years now, I've talked to students about the war.**What troubles me, Friends, is how little young Americans know about World War II.** When students ask me for advice, I tell them: _put down your cell phones and love one another._ But I can't get to every classroom, Friends.**That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. They make sure the next generation hears the truth from the people who lived it.** AVC is a nonprofit educational organization dedicated to preserving and promoting the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes:
---
* **The National Memorial Day Parade** in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event
* **The Annual Veterans Conference** every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen
* **AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes,** a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide
* **Oral histories and documentaries** that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never lost

---
AVC is funded entirely by people like you, and every gift is tax-deductible. _**[Friends, will you help with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give today, so young Americans learn what freedom costs from the men and women who paid it?](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkb-OnDAQh5_GdIcY22uWwkWU1Uop7tqU1mQYWOuwTWwDrx9xu12q60bz5_v00_x-d-_oFx_nDwxsafcuF-cPLLimY0q5Hulg_ixOdtK8AbyBckjV7-w0NqOl0SjZsIV-0JehA31tHpZJ0pWGq1Rm0BdSJDVPEoz8Y65mGvrG2xMHAAp6uKihnRSCZsCuJ2DsQehuW0esXFpKsXDe8XT6GNNZpdhSCs1iH7WuRagfQt6FvBemLXOLgbMnjDtXzhgLcayc25RnIe_zxqW64ufI-ZnKIf0V6l7SlokdpZGFuv389QFG6g6ENFsNLvDotyDUjQP65dV8ngh1e2AesXx-kZ4jwrCin6NQN9zJ_W997VXOJ7XJdlwPvyy-mF7obj4tXxnrt5-yW_kvAAD__9vxnm8)**_
---

Wally King First Lieutenant, U.S. Army Air Forces 513th Fighter Squadron, 406th Fighter Group, Ninth Air ForceOn behalf of American Veterans Center,

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, I want you
to hear me on this:

Once our Democratic trifecta is sworn into office in January, we’re not
going to waste a second.

We’re going to more than double Pennsylvania’s minimum wage.

We’re going to codify abortion rights into our state Constitution.

We’re going to fund mass transit.

We’re going to build more housing.

These are the commonsense things that Pennsylvanians want done. Voters
made that crystal clear exactly ten days ago.

And with a Democratic trifecta, we’ll deliver on every single one of them.
You have my word on that.

Derek, I’ve always
believed in reaching across the aisle to get things done. I’ve done it for
nearly four years at this point — serving as one of just a handful of
governors working with a divided legislature.

But Republicans learned something this year: If you’re going to screw over
Pennsylvania families — by cutting SNAP benefits, gutting healthcare, or
wrecking every opportunity to raise the minimum wage here in PA — we’re
going to hold you accountable at the ballot box.

And Derek,
that’s exactly what we did.

Folks here in Pennsylvania voted for a different future. A better future.
And I intend to deliver that future, in every way I possibly can. [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23225?t=1001&akid=943%2E245147%2EY-htay ]And
if you’re with me, I’d be honored to have your support in the months
ahead.

These are the commonsense things that Pennsylvanians want done. Voters made that crystal clear exactly ten days ago. And with a Democratic trifecta, we’ll deliver on every single one of them. You have my word on that. Derek, I’ve always believed in reaching across the aisle to get things done. I’ve done it for nearly four years at this point — serving as one of just a handful of governors working with a divided legislature. But Republicans learned something this year: If you’re going to screw over Pennsylvania families — by cutting SNAP benefits, gutting healthcare, or wrecking every opportunity to raise the minimum wage here in PA — we’re going to hold you accountable at the ballot box. And Derek, that’s exactly what we did. Folks here in Pennsylvania voted for a different future. A better future. And I intend to deliver that future, in every way I possibly can. [ ]And if you’re with me, I’d be honored to have your support in the months ahead. [ ]Donate Let’s get to work. Josh Shapiro

Peter,

This week, I joined the rest of the incoming class of the 120th Congress for New Member Orientation, and I want you to be among the first to hear how it went.

As a teacher, the best way I can describe it is the first day of school before classes actually begin. We spent the week getting to know the colleagues we’ll be serving alongside, both new and longtime members of the House, and getting an early look at the agenda that will be waiting for us when the new Congress begins.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143405770/660104097/902181018?refcode=em-11.13.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGU1NWQzZGYtODdkZi1mMTExLTkxZjAtMDAwZDNhMThlMjQ0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AjIiwnOy4JX-I8MkuD5sN8C9w1-cIh3kbvnuUOkbvDo=)
I had a great time meeting so many new people, but I went into every meeting and every conversation with one question in mind: how can I deliver for the families of the Central Valley? That will be my focus from day one.

Between now and swearing-in, I’ll keep you updated on how we’re preparing to hit the ground running. **If you have questions, concerns, or something you want me to know about what matters most to you, just hit reply to this email, because I want to hear from you.**

Before I go, there’s one more thing I want to ask of you. Not every Democrat elected this month has had their race called yet, and some outgoing Republicans are clinging to power by forcing recounts in races they lost.

**One of them is my fellow educator Jake Johnson in Minnesota, who is leading by just over 300 votes in a district Trump won by 12 points. A recount is expensive, and Jake needs the resources to make sure every legal ballot is counted and this seat doesn’t slip away.**

[**Peter, will you split a donation between our campaign and Jake’s recount fund so he can protect his lead through every step of the recount and keep this seat in the Democrats’ column?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143405771/660104098/902181018?refcode=em-11.13.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGU1NWQzZGYtODdkZi1mMTExLTkxZjAtMDAwZDNhMThlMjQ0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AjIiwnOy4JX-I8MkuD5sN8C9w1-cIh3kbvnuUOkbvDo=)

Thank you for everything. I’ll be in touch soon.

Randy

O'Keefe Defense Fund • Legal Update
Patriot, I've been deposed more times than I can count. I've sat across the table from attorneys whose entire assignment was to intimidate me, confuse me, and convince me to quit. So when I say I understand how this game operates, I mean it. Back in 2020, one of those depositions was captured on video. I recently released part of that footage, and I want you to understand what happened. I told the lawyers exactly what I thought: “You brought me here against my will. You're the one suing us. You're the ones admitting that you're using this as a device to stop us.” Then I made a promise: “So help me God, I will not stop fighting.” And the lawyer's response? | | **“Well, we think you're a national disgrace, Mr. O'Keefe.”**
---|---
